chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: End of his first marriage; coming home to open a restaurant
summary: His first wife left after he had been on the road, and after Redman, Carter and Snub Mosely he came home in 1943 and opened a restaurant.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: How were things between you and your first wife at this stage? The marriage must have been under quite a strain.
Yeah. My first wife... I started (?) running down through Virginia, so when I got back here, she quit me.
And that was the end of that marriage?
Yeah, that was the end of the marriage.
That was about two in a row.
Yes. See, that's what I'm speaking of. See, when you're on the road, you have problems.
So then you had the band here with Charlie Parker and Odell. Then you went back to New York again.
And this was the time when you were at the Woodside arranging.
And it was after that that you went first with Don Redman...
Yeah. And then with Snub Mosely. So I had to give it up and come home. I had saved me up a little changed, and I came home and opened up a restaurant.
